# semaphore_ex_project_policy_guardrail_diff (Ephemeral Resource)

Evaluates or compares policy guardrails without publishing or saving a policy. Opening this ephemeral resource evaluates the preview; results are not persisted in Terraform state. LDAP/OIDC previews record server-side reconciliation history. No automatic apply, renewal or deletion of audit history is performed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "semaphore_ex_project_policy_guardrail_diff" "example" {
  project_id    = 1
  from_revision = 1
  to_revision   = 2
}

# Reference ephemeral.semaphore_ex_project_policy_guardrail_diff.example.result in an ephemeral context.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from_revision` (Number)
- `project_id` (Number)
- `to_revision` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `result` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Complete native result, excluding any preview token. It is ephemeral and never stored in Terraform state. Sensitive because results may describe identity or execution metadata.
